session-static-x86_64-full-os-v1.purpose: Unmodified upstream cosmic-session without optional systemd/logind or autostart. The 512 MiB build bound is experimental, not a measured successful peak. Image backing and charged stack match full-os-v1/v2/v3 (64 MiB including 2 MiB stack). The unchanged builder still applies its legacy 16 MiB LOAD-address inspector before these bounds; larger linked output requires separate full-OS admission. Runtime requires a real session bus and real COSMIC child executables.
